Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.ArticleDe.note: Delta ranges over square checkerboard matrices of every positive order K(Delta). Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.bernstein.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ),
  have B := C.bernstein (m + 1) (n + 1) ⋯ ⋯;
  have D := Verification.bernsteinGridMatrix C m n;
  B.spearmanRho = 12 * ∑ i, ∑ j, 1 / ((↑m + 2) * (↑n + 2)) * D i j - 3 ∧
    B.kendallTau =
        1 - (Verification.bernsteinThetaMatrix m * D * Verification.bernsteinThetaMatrix n * D.transpose).trace ∧
      B.chatterjeeXi =
          6 * (Verification.bernsteinUpsilonMatrix m * D * Verification.bernsteinLambdaMatrix n * D.transpose).trace -
            2 ∧
        B.HasLowerTailDependence 0 ∧ B.HasUpperTailDependence 0

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (u v : ↑unitInterval),
  (C.bernstein m n hm hn).cdf ![u, v] =
    ∑ i, ∑ j, C.cdf ![bernstein.z i, bernstein.z j] * (bernstein m ↑i) u * (bernstein n ↑j) v
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n), (C.bernstein m n hm hn).HasLowerTailDependence 0

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n),
  (C.bernstein m n hm hn).spearmanRho =
    12 * ∑ i, ∑ j, 1 / ((↑m + 1) * (↑n + 1)) * C.cdf ![bernstein.z i.succ, bernstein.z j.succ] - 3

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n),
  (C.bernstein m n hm hn).spearmanRho =
    (12 * ∑ i, ∑ j, C.cdf ![bernstein.z i.succ, bernstein.z j.succ]) / ((↑m + 1) * (↑n + 1)) - 3

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ),
  (C.bernstein (m + 1) (n + 1) ⋯ ⋯).kendallTau =
    1 -
      (Verification.bernsteinThetaMatrix m * Verification.bernsteinGridMatrix C m n *
            Verification.bernsteinThetaMatrix n *
          (Verification.bernsteinGridMatrix C m n).transpose).trace

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (u v : ↑unitInterval),
  |(C.bernstein m n hm hn).cdf ![u, v] - C.cdf ![u, v]| ≤ √(1 / (4 * ↑m)) + √(1 / (4 * ↑n))
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n), (C.bernstein m n hm hn).HasUpperTailDependence 0

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (m n : ℕ),
  (C.bernstein (m + 1) (n + 1) ⋯ ⋯).chatterjeeXi =
    6 *
        (Verification.bernsteinUpsilonMatrix m * Verification.bernsteinGridMatrix C m n *
              Verification.bernsteinLambdaMatrix n *
            (Verification.bernsteinGridMatrix C m n).transpose).trace -
      2

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.checkerbo.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (leX : α → α → Bool) (leY : β → β → Bool) (xs : ℕ → List α) (ys : ℕ → List β),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), (xs n).length = n + 1) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), (ys n).length = n + 1) →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ),
        0 ≤ κ →
          κ ≤ 1 / 3 →
            (fun n =>
                ↑(Verification.checkerboardEstimatorWork leX leY (xs n) (ys n)
                    (Verification.powerGridIndex κ n + 1))) =O[Filter.atTop]
              fun n => (↑n + 1) * Real.log (↑n + 1)

∀ (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto N Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    ∀
      (A :
        (k : ℕ) →
          ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (N k + 1) ⋯)
            (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (N k + 1) ⋯)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Verification.checkerboardEstimator (A k) - (A k).checkerboard.chatterjeeXi) Filter.atTop
        (nhds 0)

∀ (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto N Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    ∀
      (A :
        (k : ℕ) →
          ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (N k + 1) ⋯)
            (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (N k + 1) ⋯))
      (l : ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Verification.checkerboardEstimator (A k)) Filter.atTop (nhds l) ↔
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (A k).checkerboard.chatterjeeXi) Filter.atTop (nhds l)

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.HasMTP2Density →
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n),
      (C.cellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
              (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn)).checkerboard.chatterjeeXi ≤
        C.chatterjeeXi

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (D : ℕ → ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (N : ℕ → ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto N Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    ∀ (ε : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ (k : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (u v : ↑unitInterval), |(D k).cdf ![u, v] - C.cdf ![u, v]| ≤ ε k) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (↑(N k) + 1) * ε k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun k =>
              ((D k).cellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (N k + 1) ⋯)
                    (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (N k + 1) ⋯)).checkerboard.chatterjeeXi)
            Filter.atTop (nhds C.chatterjeeXi)

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.majorizat.type:
∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f →
    (∀ i < n - 1, b (i + 1) ≤ b i) →
      (∀ k ≤ n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, b i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i) →
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, b i →
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f (b i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f (a i)

∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ i < n - 1, b (i + 1) ≤ b i) →
    (∀ k ≤ n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, b i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i) →
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, b i →
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, b i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ^ 2

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.patchwork.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) {m n : ℕ} (P : ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition m)
  (Q : ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition n) (D : Fin m → Fin n → ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (i : Fin (m + 1))
  (j : Fin (n + 1)), ((C.cellMass P Q).patchwork D).cdf ![P.point i, Q.point j] = C.cdf ![P.point i, Q.point j]

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (D : (k : ℕ) → Fin (k + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  TendstoUniformly
    (fun k =>
      ((C.cellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (k + 1) ⋯)
              (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (k + 1) ⋯)).patchwork
          (D k)).cdf)
    C.cdf Filter.atTop

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.permutati.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (u v : ↑unitInterval),
  (Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.permutationShuffle n π).cdf ![u, v] =
    ∑ i,
      Min.min (Verification.stripCut (1 / (↑n + 1)) (↑↑i / (↑n + 1)) ↑u)
        (Verification.stripCut (1 / (↑n + 1)) (↑↑(π i) / (↑n + 1)) ↑v)

∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  (Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.permutationShuffle n π).HasLowerTailDependence (if π 0 = 0 then 1 else 0)

∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  (Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.permutationShuffle n π).spearmanRho =
    1 - (6 * ∑ i, (↑↑(π i) - ↑↑i) ^ 2) / (↑n + 1) ^ 3

∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  (Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.permutationShuffle n π).kendallTau =
    1 - 4 * ↑(Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.permutationInversions n π) / (↑n + 1) ^ 2

∀ (n : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))),
  (Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.permutationShuffle n π).HasUpperTailDependence
    (if π (Fin.last n) = Fin.last n then 1 else 0)

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.rankCopul.type:
∀ {m r n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (rx ry : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (P : ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition m)
  (Q : ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition r) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin r),
  ((Verification.rankCopula n hn rx ry).cellMass P Q).mass i j =
    ↑n *
      ∑ k,
        Verification.cellOverlap P (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn) i (rx k) *
          Verification.cellOverlap Q (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn) j (ry k)

∀ (K n : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) (hn : 0 < n),
  K ≤ n →
    ∀ (rx ry : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i j : Fin K),
      ((Verification.rankCopula n hn rx ry).cellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform K hK)
              (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform K hK)).mass
          i j =
        ↑n *
          ∑ k,
            ∑ a,
              ∑ b,
                (if ↑i = ↑(rx k) * K / n + ↑a then
                    Verification.cellOverlap (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform K hK)
                      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn) i (rx k)
                  else 0) *
                  if ↑j = ↑(ry k) * K / n + ↑b then
                    Verification.cellOverlap (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform K hK)
                      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn) j (ry k)
                  else 0

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.realSampl.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (ν : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (Fin 2 → ℝ))
  (hc : ∀ (d : Fin 2), Continuous ↑(ProbabilityTheory.cdf (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.marginal ν d)))
  (X : ℕ → Ω → Fin 2 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) →
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) μ = ↑ν) →
        ∀ (κ : ℝ),
          0 < κ →
            κ ≤ 1 / 3 →
              ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ,
                Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Verification.realSampleCheckerboardEstimator X κ n ω) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.ofContinuousMarginals ν hc).chatterjeeXi)

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.rectangul.type:
∀ {m n : ℕ}
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (m + 1) ⋯)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (n + 1) ⋯)),
  A.checkMin.HasLowerTailDependence (A.mass 0 0 * Min.min (↑m + 1) (↑n + 1))

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn)),
  A.checkMin.spearmanRho = A.checkerboard.spearmanRho + 1 / (↑m * ↑n)

∀ {m n : ℕ}
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (m + 1) ⋯)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (n + 1) ⋯)),
  A.checkMin.HasUpperTailDependence (A.mass (Fin.last m) (Fin.last n) * Min.min (↑m + 1) (↑n + 1))

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn)),
  A.checkMin.chatterjeeXi =
    A.checkerboard.chatterjeeXi + ↑m / ↑n * ((Matrix.of A.mass).transpose * Matrix.of A.mass).trace

∀ {m n : ℕ}
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (m + 1) ⋯)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (n + 1) ⋯)),
  A.checkW.HasLowerTailDependence 0

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn)),
  A.checkW.spearmanRho = A.checkerboard.spearmanRho - 1 / (↑m * ↑n)

∀ {m n : ℕ}
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (m + 1) ⋯)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (n + 1) ⋯)),
  A.checkW.HasUpperTailDependence 0

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn)),
  A.checkW.chatterjeeXi =
    A.checkerboard.chatterjeeXi + ↑m / ↑n * ((Matrix.of A.mass).transpose * Matrix.of A.mass).trace

∀ {m n : ℕ}
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (m + 1) ⋯)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (n + 1) ⋯)),
  A.checkerboard.HasLowerTailDependence 0

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn)),
  A.checkerboard.spearmanRho =
    3 * ∑ i, ∑ j, (2 * ↑m - 2 * (↑↑i + 1) + 1) * (2 * ↑n - 2 * (↑↑j + 1) + 1) / (↑m * ↑n) * A.mass i j - 3

∀ {m n : ℕ} {P : ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition m} {Q : ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition n}
  (A : ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass P Q),
  A.checkerboard.kendallTau =
    1 -
      (Verification.checkerXiMatrix m * Matrix.of A.mass * Verification.checkerXiMatrix n *
          (Matrix.of A.mass).transpose).trace

∀ {m n : ℕ}
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (m + 1) ⋯)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform (n + 1) ⋯)),
  A.checkerboard.HasUpperTailDependence 0

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn)),
  A.checkerboard.chatterjeeXi =
    6 * ↑m / ↑n * ((Matrix.of A.mass).transpose * Matrix.of A.mass * Verification.checkerboardXiMatrix n).trace - 2

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn))
  (C : Fin m → Fin n → ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  (∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n), (C i j).chatterjeeXi = 1) →
    (A.patchwork C).chatterjeeXi =
      A.checkerboard.chatterjeeXi + ↑m / ↑n * ((Matrix.of A.mass).transpose * Matrix.of A.mass).trace

∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn))
  (C : Fin m → Fin n → ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  |(A.patchwork C).chatterjeeXi - A.checkerboard.chatterjeeXi| ≤ if m ≤ n then ↑m / ↑n ^ 2 else 1 / ↑n

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.sampleChe.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (X : ℕ → Ω → Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) →
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) μ = C.toMeasure) →
        ∀ (κ : ℝ),
          0 < κ →
            κ ≤ 1 / 3 →
              ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ,
                Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Verification.sampleCheckerboardEstimator X κ n ω) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds C.chatterjeeXi)

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.sampleRan.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (X : ℕ → Ω → Fin 2 → ↑unitInterval),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable (X i)) →
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (X i) μ = C.toMeasure) →
        ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ,
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            ∀ (u v : ↑unitInterval),
              |(Verification.sampleRankCopula X n ω).cdf ![u, v] - C.cdf ![u, v]| ≤
                3 * Verification.empiricalCDFRadius n + 8 / (↑n + 1)

Papers.Rockel2025Approximation.uniform_p.type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n)
  (A :
    ProbabilityTheory.Copula.CellMass (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform m hm)
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.IntervalPartition.uniform n hn))
  (C : Fin m → Fin n → ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  (A.patchwork C).chatterjeeXi = A.checkerboard.chatterjeeXi + ↑m / ↑n * ∑ i, ∑ j, A.mass i j ^ 2 * (C i j).chatterjeeXi
